Multi_Facetted_Compound_Eyes.description: Brimming with an eerie, multifaceted brilliance, the compound eyes of this entity offer unparalleled perception, allowing it to detect even the subtlest movements and hues, granting it an edge in both stealth and combat.

Glow_in_the_Dark_Firefly_Eyes.description: Adorned with iridescent wings and eyes that emit a soft, otherworldly glow, these firefly eyes grant the bearer unparalleled vision in the darkest of nights, enhancing their perception and wisdom as they navigate through realms cloaked in shadows, casting a faint light that both guides and mesmerizes.

Eight_Eyed_Tarantula_Visor.description: The Eight-Eyed Tarantula Visor is a fearsome cephalon component, brimming with the predatory essence of an arachnid, granting enhanced perception and dexterity, along with the innate skills of Alert and Darkvision, allowing its wearer to see and react with uncanny precision in the darkest of environments.

Vibrant_Moth_Patterned_Eyes.description: The Vibrant_Moth_Patterned_Eyes are iridescent orbs, shimmering with the hypnotic patterns of nocturnal moths, their vibrant colors pulsing with arcane energy that enhances the bearer's charisma and perception, and grants the enchanting ability to lure prey or captivate observers.

Ghost_Mantis_Ghost_Eyes.description: The Ghost_Mantis_Ghost_Eyes, a spectral appendage shimmering with otherworldly light, grants its bearer an ethereal sight that pierces the veil of the mundane, revealing the hidden and the spectral, while its innate camouflage ability allows it to blend into shadows, making it nearly invisible to the living and the dead alike.

Hardened_Beetle_Shell_Eye_Slits.description: The Hardened Beetle Shell Eye Slits are narrow slits set within a thick, chitinous cephalon, offering a limited but unyielding protection against harm while slightly impairing peripheral vision, enhancing natural armor and providing a means to block attacks at the cost of broader awareness.

Acid_Resistant_Ant_Eyes.description: These eyes, adapted from the relentless and toxic acid ants, are not only impervious to acidic substances but also grant a heightened perception of the environment, making the user acutely aware of potential threats and enhancing their constitution against the debilitating effects of poison.

Predatory_Wasp_Targeting_Eyes.description: The Predatory Wasp's targeting eyes are iridescent orbs that shimmer with an eerie, blue-green light, granting them exceptional clarity and speed in their vision, allowing them to track and strike with deadly precision.

Stalk_Eyed_Fly_Eyes.description: Glowing with an eerie luminescence, the Stalk-Eyed Fly Eyes are a pair of insectoid ocular organs nestled within a cephalon, each eye a marvel of biological adaptation that grants unparalleled perception and the uncanny ability to see in the dark, enhancing one's awareness and vigilance.

Subterranean_Mole_Cricket_Eyes.description: Embedded deep within the cephalon of the subterranean mole cricket, these eyes are adapted to pierce the darkness with an uncanny clarity, granting the creature not only darkvision but also the ability to sense the slightest vibrations through the soil, making it a formidable predator in the underground realms.
